title: Figma Basic header placeholders, masked values and client id
summary: A Basic header with a placeholder, an environment or template reference, a masked value or no value, a client id alone and a masked client_secret field.
rationale: A placeholder, reference or masked display stands in for a value kept elsewhere, a scheme with no value carries nothing, and the client id is a public identifier that appears on its own in app configuration.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Not flagged under project policy: these inputs hold no credential value. That a placeholder, reference or public client id is not a value is a project decision, not a Figma statement.

sources.supports: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret for your OAuth app and store them securely. This is the only opportunity you have to obtain the Client Secret. The secret is required for token exchange and refreshing access tokens.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
